note: satb-s0b: ts3native 0.36.133 (asi.satb2, ts3fixes mc14 = contract 9, docs/206 §9): satb-s0 again after the IC argument fix (0.36.125 read every argument dword up to the last byref parameter, so object ids counted as shared pointers: 5.0 / 6.5 unlogged events a job, model 72 / 142 ms/s STOP; now each byref/array argument into shared memory has its range logged, only oversized ranges, MonoField.SetValue and PtrToStructure still wait) and with [MonoThread] LazyGate=1 (satb-s0 had it off: GC lock line 36 ms/s). Same S0 probe on BP and IP = mono-cost13's Mode R config + [AutShadow] Satb=1 (probe: after each job, the sim's stores, first-written words, pages, loads and IC/runtime writer events are counted for one worker-job length of the next tick, the time a concurrent job would need the log; the worker still runs only in the window with WindowWaitUs, no concurrency). Goal: the docs/206 §5 gate. Read with node tools/harness/mono-cost-report.ts --tag satb-s0b: the 'Satb probe per job span' and 'Satb barrier at go-live' lines: PASS = <= 3 ms/s and <= 20k words a job; STOP = > 5 ms/s or > 4 MB log (docs/206 §5: then no Satb=2 queue). Correctness unchanged from mono-cost13 (A1-A3 0). 2 x 10 min, ~30 min. Run before mono-cost14 or after it (independent).
